sprint: Three Real Bugs — Companion Broken-Image Fallback, Publish Celebration Overlap, Magic Card Print Race
task: Three independent, screenshot-reported bugs. (1) 'the companion did not loaded . check lower right corner' -- Quill's own defaultState pose (idle.png) is genuinely missing on disk (only 5 of 12 declared poses exist), and js/companionEngine.js's _applyState() had zero error handling, so the browser's native broken-image glyph + wrapped alt text rendered directly in the small circular portrait. Fixed with an onerror fallback to the package's own defaultState pose (mirroring the established pattern already proven in js/magicCardUI.js's _playCeremonyBeats), with a final companion-portrait-img-broken/visibility:hidden state if even that fails -- the glow ring/environment beneath it still reads as 'someone is here.' (2) 'top is getting overlapped' -- Publish Studio's Celebration heading clipped against the modal header at short viewport heights. Root cause confirmed via real Playwright-measured geometry: .publish-studio-body-celebration combined align-items:center/justify-content:center with overflow:hidden, silently clipping the TOP of overflowing centered content. Fixed with overflow-y:auto + clamp()-based padding/gap trims + align-items:safe center (the established 'Magic Card Home Scroll Fix' pattern, reused after stress-testing an even shorter viewport surfaced the related 'safe center' scroll trap). Verified at 4 viewport heights, zero overlap at every one. (3) 'print for magic card not working' -- js/magicCardArt.js's printCard() called window.print() immediately after setting .src to data: URIs, with zero wait for the browser to actually decode them -- a real race producing blank placeholder rectangles in the print preview (cross-origin canvas tainting was investigated and ruled out first, via confirming same-origin asset URLs and that window.print() visibly executed). Fixed with an img.decode()-based wait (onload fallback) before window.print() fires; the byte-for-byte identical race, confirmed present in World Builder v2's sibling _printCardArt() (ported verbatim per magicCardArt.js's own header comment), was fixed there too in lockstep. Verified via a new Playwright suite (three_bug_batch_verify.js, 17/17 assertions) -- a synthetic companion package with a missing pose falls back correctly; a package with both the pose AND defaultState missing correctly hides via visibility:hidden (a real test-script bug was found and fixed along the way: an earlier CompanionEngine instance in the same page session had already mounted its own independent widget, so an unscoped querySelector picked up the wrong engine's element); the Celebration heading shows zero overlap across all tested heights; printCard()'s window.print() is confirmed, via a monkey-patched decode() recording call order, to fire only after both images finish decoding; World Builder v2's worldBuilderApp.js loads with zero syntax errors. Older scratch scripts (publish_stages.js, magic_card_test.js, etc.) predating the Traveller Gateway's own skip-helper convention were confirmed to call no skipGateway() at all, the same pre-existing, already-documented staleness class this codebase's history has confirmed dozens of times, unrelated to this fix. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/companionEngine.js, css/style.css, js/magicCardArt.js, and tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
